metrics.name: ROC AUC
metrics.description: Binary ranking AUC with half-credit for tied scores; both classes required.

metrics.name: Average precision (AP)
metrics.description: AP is recall-increment-weighted precision, not trapezoidal PR area; positives required.

metrics.name: Brier score
metrics.description: Mean squared error of binary event probabilities.

metrics.name: Calibration groups
metrics.description: Uniform bins report predicted mean, observed event rate, and count. Optional n_bins defaults to 10; empty-bin means are null.

metrics.name: Confusion matrix
metrics.description: Binary counts at an explicitly approved threshold; score >= threshold is positive.

metrics.name: Accuracy
metrics.description: Correct binary predictions divided by evaluated rows at an explicit threshold.

metrics.name: Recall (sensitivity)
metrics.description: TP / (TP + FN) at an explicit threshold; undefined without positives.

metrics.name: Specificity
metrics.description: TN / (TN + FP) at an explicit threshold; undefined without negatives.

metrics.name: Precision (positive predictive value)
metrics.description: PPV = TP / (TP + FP) at an explicit threshold; undefined without positive predictions.

metrics.name: Negative predictive value
metrics.description: NPV = TN / (TN + FN) at an explicit threshold; undefined without negative predictions.

metrics.name: F1 score
metrics.description: 2TP / (2TP + FP + FN) at an explicit threshold; a zero denominator remains undefined.

metrics.name: Decision curve analysis (DCA)
metrics.description: Model, treat-all and treat-none net benefit at explicit strictly increasing thresholds in (0,1), conditional on a described clinical action.

metrics.name: Categorical net reclassification improvement
metrics.description: New y_probability versus reference_probabilities using identically ordered unique sample IDs, both classes and pre-specified strictly increasing risk cutoffs in (0,1). Cutoff equality enters the higher category. Not proof of incremental clinical benefit.

metrics.name: Recall at top fraction
metrics.description: Captured positives / all positives for ceil(N * top_fraction) alerts; fraction must be in (0,1]. Ties preserve input order and never expand the alert budget.

metrics.name: Precision at top fraction
metrics.description: Captured positives / ceil(N * top_fraction) alerts; fraction must be in (0,1]. Stable input-order ties, explicit alert and captured-positive counts.
